identity.description: Makes APY/APR, staking, lending, and inflation-adjusted yields comparable. Explains annualization, compounding, and methodology differences so users don't treat unlike yields as equivalent. Flags asterisked assets and reveals whether displayed percentages are meaningful for comparison.

capabilities.dataCoverage: 59 assets, 8 quarterly periods, annualized vs non-annualized tracking

inputs.description: Yield comparison question with optional asset or category filter and metric preferences.

outputs.description: Comparable yield analysis with methodology notes, annualization flags, and caveats.

skill.userValue: Use methodology notes and annualization flags to avoid treating unlike yield mechanisms as directly comparable. Verify APR/APY conventions, compounding, lockups, fees, and reward assets with the provider.
